title: HSF1 modulates lipid metabolism and ferroptosis in sarcopenia: a novel diagnostic biomarker and therapeutic target
summary: Methods and Results: RNA-seq GSE25941/GSE9103; WGCNA and LASSO/SVM/KNN/XGBoost/NNET shortlist six FRGs; HSF1 highest diagnostic AUC (0.9247); C2C12 silencing/overexpression assays measure lipid metabolism, ferroptosis and atrophy markers.
